stem:
Padma connects a small lamp to one cell with copper wires.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The lamp glows with only one wire from one cell terminal to the lamp.
The lamp glows when wires join the lamp from one cell terminal to the other cell terminal.
The lamp glows only if its bottom contact is on the positive terminal, even when both cell terminals are joined.
The lamp glows when it is held near the cell with no wires.

teacher.key_rationale: The lamp needs a complete path through both cell terminals. Filament-lamp contact polarity is not required.
